name: 圣光重召
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var existing = caster.statusTags && caster.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'divine-shield'; }); if (existing) return { success: false, message: '已经拥有圣盾' }; addStatusEffectById(caster.instanceId, { id: 'divine-shield', name: '圣盾', type: 'divine-shield', currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1, relatedRules: ['rule-divine-shield'] }); addRuleById(caster.instanceId, 'rule-divine-shield'); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '以圣光重召获得圣盾' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview() { return { description: '获得圣盾。', expectedValues: { shield: 1 } }; }
